---
title: "rtichoke single browser summary report acceptance"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: false
---

<iframe id="report-one" src="summary-report-one.html" style="width:100%;height:1800px;border:0"></iframe>
<div id="acceptance-status" data-ready="false"></div>

<script>
(() => {
  const status = document.querySelector("#acceptance-status");
  const frame = document.querySelector("#report-one");

  function poll() {
    const doc = frame.contentDocument;
    if (doc) {
      const component = id => doc.querySelector(`[data-component-id="${id}"]`);
      const table = component("performance-table")?.querySelector("table.rtichoke-performance-table__table");
      const ppcrTable = component("performance-table-2")?.querySelector("table.rtichoke-performance-table__table");
      const discreteCalibration = component("calibration")?.querySelector("svg");
      const precisionRecall = component("precision-recall")?.querySelector("svg");
      const decisionCurve = component("decision-curve")?.querySelector("svg");
      const interventionsAvoided = component("interventions-avoided")?.querySelector("svg");
      const report = doc.querySelector(".rtichoke-report");
      const discrimination = doc.querySelector('[data-section-id="discrimination"]');
      const utility = doc.querySelector('[data-section-id="utility"]');
      const calibration = doc.querySelector('[data-section-id="calibration"]');
      const performanceTable = doc.querySelector('[data-section-id="performance-table"]');
      const discriminationTabs = discrimination?.querySelectorAll(':scope > .rtichoke-report__section-group-tablist > [role="tab"]');
      const performanceTableTabs = performanceTable?.querySelectorAll(':scope > .rtichoke-report__section-group-tablist > [role="tab"]');
      const discriminationGroups = discrimination?.querySelectorAll(':scope > [role="tabpanel"]');
      const stackedComponents = discriminationGroups && Array.from(discriminationGroups).every(
        group => group.querySelectorAll(':scope > [data-component-id]').length === 4 &&
          !group.querySelector('.rtichoke-report__tablist')
      );
      const directSections = calibration && utility &&
        !calibration.querySelector('.rtichoke-report__tablist') &&
        !utility.querySelector('.rtichoke-report__tablist');
      const uniqueComponents = doc.querySelectorAll('[data-component-id]').length === 13;
      const cssLoaded = Array.from(doc.styleSheets).some(sheet =>
        (sheet.href || "").includes("rtichoke-viz-0.13.0/rtichoke-viz.css")
      );
      const styled = report && getComputedStyle(report).display !== "none";
      if (table && ppcrTable && discreteCalibration && precisionRecall && decisionCurve && interventionsAvoided &&
          discriminationTabs?.length === 2 && performanceTableTabs?.length === 2 &&
          discriminationGroups?.length === 2 && stackedComponents && directSections && uniqueComponents &&
          cssLoaded && styled) {
        discriminationTabs[1].click();
        const mouseSwitch = discriminationTabs[1].getAttribute("aria-selected") === "true" &&
          !discriminationGroups[1].hidden && discriminationGroups[0].hidden &&
          !!component("precision-recall-2")?.querySelector("svg");
        discriminationTabs[1].dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "ArrowLeft", bubbles: true }));
        const keyboardSwitch = discriminationTabs[0].getAttribute("aria-selected") === "true" &&
          !discriminationGroups[0].hidden && discriminationGroups[1].hidden &&
          !!component("precision-recall")?.querySelector("svg");
        performanceTableTabs[1].click();
        const ppcrTableVisible = performanceTableTabs[1].getAttribute("aria-selected") === "true" &&
          !component("performance-table-2")?.closest('[role="tabpanel"]')?.hidden;
        if (!mouseSwitch || !keyboardSwitch || !ppcrTableVisible) return;
        status.dataset.ready = "true";
        status.dataset.table = "true";
        status.dataset.ppcrTable = "true";
        status.dataset.discreteCalibration = "true";
        status.dataset.precisionRecall = "true";
        status.dataset.decisionCurve = "true";
        status.dataset.interventionsAvoided = "true";
        status.dataset.css = "true";
        status.dataset.sectionGroupTabs = "true";
        status.dataset.stackedComponents = "true";
        status.dataset.directSections = "true";
        status.dataset.uniqueComponents = "true";
        status.dataset.mouseSwitch = "true";
        status.dataset.keyboardSwitch = "true";
        status.dataset.ppcrTableVisible = "true";
        return;
      }
    }
    setTimeout(poll, 100);
  }

  poll();
})();
</script>
